create_BlendParams: create a BlendParams instance with custom sigma, gamma, and background color values for rendering
run_hard_rgb_blend: run hard RGB blending on rasterization fragments to produce an RGBA image with nearest face colors
run_sigmoid_alpha_blend: run sigmoid alpha blending on rasterization fragments to produce an RGBA silhouette image with distance-based alpha
run_softmax_rgb_blend: run softmax RGB blending on rasterization fragments to produce an RGBA image with distance and depth weighted colors
review_SigmoidAlphaBlend: review the _SigmoidAlphaBlend autograd function wrapping the C++ CUDA sigmoid alpha blend forward and backward passes
